emoji.picker.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button of the post form that opens the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.title.description: Accessible name of the popover of the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.search.description: Label of the search field of the custom emoji picker; it finds emoji by shortcode or other name.

emoji.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.recent.description: Heading of the emoji picked recently on this device, first in the picker.

emoji.picker.uncategorized.description: Heading of the emoji without a category in the picker.

emoji.picker.empty.description: What the custom emoji picker shows when nothing matches the search.
